categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: the optoelectronics business group focusing on the development, design, manufacturing, and sales of touch panels and related display modules; and the electromechanical business group specializing in manufacturing and sales of wire and cable accessories and high-voltage cable terminal boxes. The optoelectronics segment targets industrial control, automotive, sports equipment, and electronic paper applications, while the electromechanical segment serves mainly Taiwan Power Company with high-quality, certified products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs roll-to-roll photolithography processes for thin-film touch sensors, including metal film and ITO patterning with advanced laser and CCD alignment for narrow bezel and high-sensitivity products. It also develops surface coatings for glass cover plates with anti-reflective, anti-glare, and antibacterial properties. The electromechanical segment uses casting, curing, grinding, expansion, insulation molding, and semiconductor molding processes for high-voltage cable accessories, adhering to strict quality and safety standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial control manufacturers, automotive system integrators, sports equipment producers, and Taiwan Power Company for electromechanical products. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a focus on non-consumer applications such as industrial, automotive, and electronic paper displays. The electromechanical products are mainly sold domestically to power utilities and related engineering firms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Taoyuan City and overseas production bases in Vietnam and Huizhou, China. It leverages its Vietnam factory as a production base for optoelectronics products to mitigate geopolitical risks and serve international customers. Sales are predominantly domestic (about 89%) with a smaller portion exported internationally (about 11%).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing touch sensors, modules, and electromechanical components. It vertically integrates upstream processes such as glass cover plate coating and thin-film sensor fabrication, and downstream processes including module assembly and system integration. It also collaborates closely with suppliers of raw materials like glass, PET films, and ITO targets, and supplies to system integrators and end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing cost-effective niche touch panel products, expanding product integration services from glass coating to full module assembly, and broadening applications into industrial, automotive, and electronic paper markets. R&D focuses on advanced thin-film processes, narrow bezel and high-sensitivity touch panels, anti-reflective and antibacterial coatings, and new materials such as metal mesh and nano silver wires. The company also invests in green energy and sustainability initiatives, including solar power installations and carbon reduction targets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of touch panels, display modules, and electromechanical cable accessories. The company also earns stable income from leasing idle assets and investment dividends. Sales are mostly transactional with some long-term contracts, especially in the electromechanical segment serving Taiwan Power Company. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition in the touch panel market, especially from Chinese suppliers and integrated LCD panel manufacturers adopting in-cell/on-cell technologies. It positions itself by focusing on advanced thin-film processes, niche non-consumer applications, and vertical integration to maintain competitiveness. In the electromechanical segment, the market is oligopolistic with high entry barriers due to strict certifications, allowing the company to maintain stable profitability and a strong position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.58 billion, a slight decrease from the previous year, but net profit increased by nearly 27% to NT$720 million. The company maintains a strong financial structure with low debt ratio (~9.5%), high liquidity ratios, and steady cash flows. R&D expenses accounted for about 2.6% of revenue. The company shows a stable growth trajectory supported by diversified business segments and effective cost control.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, advanced thin-film touch panel technologies with features such as ultra-thin, narrow bezel designs, and specialized surface coatings for anti-glare, anti-reflective, and antibacterial functions. Vertical integration from raw material processing to module assembly enables flexible, customized solutions for industrial and automotive customers. In the electromechanical segment, the company offers certified, reliable high-voltage cable accessories with integrated installation services, addressing labor shortages and ensuring customer satisfaction. Sustainability and ESG commitments further differentiate the company.
